v1.feedback: Strong channeling of Hilma's diagrammatic cosmology — the concentric petal-rings with esoteric symmetry counts (7, 12, 24), color-coded cosmological layers, and crosshair notation genuinely read as a living spiritual chart. Palette is well-restrained. Two refinements: the breathing amplitude (0.055 * r) is so subtle it may read as static on first glance — consider nudging to ~0.08 or adding a very slow rotational drift per ring (opposing directions, ≤0.003 rad/s) so the mandala feels alive without spinning. Second, the click-phase rebuild is abrupt — lerping particle positions between phases over ~1.5s would make the cosmogram feel like it's transforming rather than resetting.

v2.feedback: Strong Hilma channeling — the number symbolism and phase-cycling map her Group IV series convincingly. The mandala reads immediately and the palette is appropriately aged. Two refinements: the zeroed-out inactive particles (pi >= nPetals) collapse to origin and may create a visible dot cluster at center — cull them via alpha=0 AND move offscreen; and the flat z≈0 plane, while true to Hilma's diagrammatic style, would benefit from a subtle per-ring z-offset (0.05 per ring) to give parallax depth and separate the rings visually when breathing at different rates.
